mechanism: Betamethasone may increase zidovudine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing antiretroviral efficacy, while zidovudine may increase glucocorticoid levels; concurrent use also increases immunosuppression risk.
action: Monitor viral load and CD4 count; consider alternative corticosteroid or adjust zidovudine dosing; use lowest effective betamethasone dose for shortest duration.
